heading: Payroll and onboarding support for Nile Logistics
intro:
Hi Mona,

I’m reaching out about a simple way to help cover payroll and employee onboarding while your team keeps hiring moving.

Qimam People provides an outsourced HR operations desk for companies that want steady support without building a full in-house payroll team.

sections.heading: Why this may be relevant
sections.body: Your careers page currently lists payroll and HR administrator vacancies. If those roles are taking time to fill, an outsourced desk can keep the work covered in the meantime.

sections.heading: What we handle
sections.body: We run payroll and employee onboarding as one managed service. That gives your internal team a lighter workload and a clear single point of contact for day-to-day HR operations.
